ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2026 DPS 2.44 + the quarters since (2026-08-30: 0.61) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-08-24: 0.61)
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2011-05-29..2026-08-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2008-05-25..2011-02-27, 11 facts); the declared tag files quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-08-30, the paid tag only full-year facts — the quarterly tag is primary (the paid tag's full-year facts fill only fiscal years the declared tag does not cover)
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-08-24, 2025-11-23, 2026-02-22, 2026-08-30); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-23..2026-08-30
dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-23..2026-08-30

dividend_yield.basis: FY2026 DPS 2.44 + the quarters since (2026-08-30: 0.61) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-08-24: 0.61)

dividend_yield.label: —
dividend_yield.note: dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (189 days between 2026-02-22 and 2026-08-30) — FY2026 DPS 2.44 + the quarters since (2026-08-30: 0.61) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-08-24: 0.61)

notes: quarterly DPS (paid): 3 quarter(s) filed at different values on the same share basis (2009-08-30: 0.47 (filed 2009-09-24) used, not 0.24 (filed 2011-07-08) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2009-11-29: 0.47 (filed 2009-12-18) used, not 0.23 (filed 2011-07-08) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide); 2010-02-28: 0.49 (filed 2010-03-24) used, not 0.25 (filed 2011-07-08) — the filing that first reported the quarter (the year-to-date facts do not decide)) — later 10-Ks and comparatives sometimes tag a year-to-date or annual value with a three-month context

annual_dps: the paid FY DPS fact for the period ended 2009-05-31 (0.86) is below the sum of the same tag's quarterly facts inside that fiscal year (1.29), which the tag's year-to-date facts bear out or which each equal it (one quarter's rate tagged with the full-year context) — not used

annual_dps: the paid FY DPS fact for the period ended 2010-05-30 (0.96) is below the sum of the same tag's quarterly facts inside that fiscal year (1.67), which the tag's year-to-date facts bear out or which each equal it (one quarter's rate tagged with the full-year context) — not used

dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2011-05-29..2026-08-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2008-05-25..2011-02-27, 11 facts) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)
annual_dps: FY2010 = sum of the four filed quarterly DPS facts (no FY fact)
